2251 North Lincoln Avenue
Type I Zoning Map Amendment

Narrative and Plans

Subject Property

The Subject Property is improved with the two-story commercial building formerly occupied by a
restaurant. It has a land area of 5,000 square feet, and the building floor area is 10,000 square feet. The
subject property abuts Lincoln Avenue, which is a Pedestrian (“P”) Street (Sec. 17-3-0503-D2).
Additionally, the Subject Property is adjacent to the CTA Lincoln Avenue bus route and, as such, is an
Equitable Transit Location.

Narrative

The Applicant is seeking the map amendment to establish a tavern as a permitted use. The Subject
Property has no off-street parking, and none is intended. It is located on a Pedestrian (““P”) Street. Per
Section 17-3-0504-E of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, off-street parking is not required for
nonresidential uses on lots abutting pedestrian streets unless such uses exceed 10,000 square feet of gross
floor area,
